create_embodied_task: create a custom EmbodiedTask subclass that defines action space, measures, and episode logic for a new task
implement_action_step: implement the Action step method to return observations after performing an environment action
build_measure_class: build a Measure subclass with reset_metric and update_metric methods to track task statistics
use_measurements_manager: use the Measurements class to register and manage a set of Measure instances by unique uuid
check_measure_dependencies: check that required dependency measures are enabled and listed before a dependent measure in config
